Functions
cpct_scanFillM1

Fills an area defined by a point and its actual color with a new color in Mode 1 (320x200, 4 colors)

C Definition

void cpct_scanFillM1 (u8* vmem, u16 x, u8 y, u8 newColor) __z88dk_callee;

Input Parameters
(2B HL)  vmem

Base VRAM memory address (typically 0xC000)

(2B DE)  x

X coordinate (0-319 no checks)

(1B  C)  y

Y coordinate (0-199 no checks)

(1B  B)  newColor

New color to use (0-3)

Assembly call:

call cpct_scanFillM1_asm

Destroyed Register values: AF, BC, DE, HL

Algorithm & Details

Scanline Fill, starting from a point, it fills the area with the color specified.  It will stop when it finds a pixel with a different color than the one found initialy

Init algo: get screen adress from X,Y, compute X Offset and subpixel, get old color on X,Y Compute new and old_color subpixels and full octet, exit if new color == old color Push X Offset, subpixel and Y in point stack Main loop: pop a point from stack - Exit is stack was empty (no more things to do) drawOnLeft to find left most pixel which is still old_color, try to use full_octet if possible. Stop at begining of screen if needed.  drawOnRight to find right most pixel which is still old_color, try to use full_octet if possible. Stop at end of screen if needed.  get left side of line on above line (decreasing Y)  (do it again after with below line (increase y) initSubLoop set a search flag to 'search old_color' subLoop if searchFlag is 'search Old Color' check if pixel is old color if yes pushcurrent  point into stack and set search flag to 'search not old color' else  (search for 'not old color') check if pixel is old color if not set search flag to 'search old color' endif move to next pixel on the right, check if right end of previous drawnn line reached to exit subLoop try to jump over full octets old color if 'not old color' (will slow back to pixel checks if not found) new_color if 'old_color'  (only case we have values ready, else switch back to pixel check) fall back to pixel checking in doubt, exit subLoop if right end of drawn line is reached or passed

Comment on stack size: A memory buffer is set to store next points to check above and below vurrent line.  By default this is a 30 points storage using 3 Bytes each, 90 Bytes.  If area to fill has a lot of different vertical area to fill the algorithm will need all this area. The algorithm stops adding points if buffer is filled. So some area will not be checked and some area may miss in result.  A simple rectangular area just need 2 points.  If you know how many elements in stacks you need, you can adjust the STACK_SIZE value to your need and recompile cpctelera to decrease memory need.

Required memory:
   602 bytes core routine (including 3 bytes of c binding) + 115 bytes data

Test measure:
   Screen set to color 0
   4 points:
      pt1 (100,100) pt2 (125,75) pt3 (150,100) pt4 (125,125)
   4 lines of color 2 between:
      pt1,pt2  pt2,pt3 pt3,pt4 pt4,pt1
   Time to fill from pt (125,100) with color 3

 Totals and assumptions
   Pixels drawn: 1,201
   Estimated drawing work: about 28,300 NOPs
   Estimated above/below checks and point-queue costs: about 51,400 NOPs
 Estimated overall:
   about 80,000 NOPs, including roughly 30 NOPs for the initial screen-pointer helper and the documented 10-NOP C-binding overhead; allow a few hundred more for setup.
